description: This file defines HTTP handlers for managing and querying execution data within a UI context for a control plane. It includes handlers for listing executions, retrieving detailed execution info, streaming events via Server-Sent Events, and managing webhook retries. The code integrates with storage, services, and logging components, and provides utilities for data decoding and formatting.

classes.name: ExecutionHandler
classes.description: Handler struct providing methods to interact with execution data, including listing, retrieving, streaming, and managing webhook retries.

methods.name: writeSSE
methods.description: Utility function to write Server-Sent Events payloads to the client connection.

methods.name: toExecutionSummary
methods.description: Converts a detailed execution object into a summarized form suitable for listing endpoints.

methods.name: toExecutionDetails
methods.description: Converts a detailed execution object into a comprehensive detailed response for client consumption.

methods.name: resolveExecutionData
methods.description: Resolves execution payload data either directly or via stored payloads, supporting large data handling and fallback.

methods.name: loadPayloadData
methods.description: Loads payload data from a URI through the payload store, handles large payloads and errors.

methods.name: groupExecutionSummaries
methods.description: Groups execution summaries based on a specified attribute for summary analytics.
